answer: Randomized Residency Windows. Each epoch a verifiable beacon emits a pulse that seeds assignment of agent slots to registration windows; only identities allocated a window may act, and assignment is unknowable until the beacon fires. A falcon cannot precompute which slot it will win, so bulk registrations must wait live. Duplicates caught sharing one window lose that window's standing. An attacker must field distinct agents per window, paying registration and idle latency each cycle; unused lotus slots expire.
